t: Find Good Days to Rob the Bank — Streak Precomputation
o: **Understanding the problem.** Day i is good when guard counts non-increase into day i over the previous `time` days and non-decrease away from it over the next `time` days — equality is allowed everywhere. In `[5,3,3,3,5,6,2]` with time = 2, day 2 has 5>=3>=3 before and 3<=3<=5 after, and day 3 checks out identically; no other day does. With time = 0 both conditions are vacuous, so every day qualifies. Because n and time both reach $10^5$, rescanning up to `time` neighbors per day can cost $10^{10}$ comparisons — we want each verdict in O(1) after linear preprocessing.
k: nonInc[i] = length of the non-increasing run ending at i, nonDec[i] = the non-decreasing run starting at i; day i is good iff both reach time.
Both arrays are one-line recurrences: extend the neighbor streak or reset to zero.
time = 0 makes the predicate vacuously true — the streak test handles this uniformly.

a.i: For every candidate day with enough neighbors, scan the `time` predecessors and successors verifying the two monotone runs. This mirrors the definition literally but redoes overlapping work for neighboring days.
s: Loop i from time to n-1-time.
Collect every i passing both checks.
a.t: O(n * time) — up to 10^10 comparisons at full constraints, so TLE risk; fine for small inputs.

a.i: One left-to-right pass builds nonInc: extending the previous run when security[i-1] >= security[i], resetting otherwise. A mirrored right-to-left pass builds nonDec. Each day then needs just two comparisons against `time`.
s: Build nonInc: nonInc[i] = nonInc[i-1] + 1 if security[i-1] >= security[i], else 0.
Build nonDec backwards: nonDec[i] = nonDec[i+1] + 1 if security[i] <= security[i+1], else 0.
Return every i with nonInc[i] >= time and nonDec[i] >= time.
a.sp: O(n) — the two streak arrays, output excluded.

w: Sketch the brute force, then pivot immediately to streak arrays — interviewers expect the prefix/suffix observation. Pitfalls: using strict inequalities (equal counts are explicitly permitted); boundaries need no special casing because streak lengths simply cannot reach `time` near the edges; remember time = 0 returns all days. Follow-up: fold the suffix pass into a running counter for O(1) extra space — same asymptotics, trickier bookkeeping.
